newsitem.title: USA: Dress Barn stake cut by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Dress Barn stake cut by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by former Fidelity Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik said Wednesday it reduced its stake in Dress Barn to 1,266,800 common shares or 5.6 percent from 8.3 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 619,600 sold between January 28 and March 11 at prices ranging from $15.3750 to $18.4994 per share.
Dress Barn, based in Stamford, Conn., is engaged in the operation of women's apparel stores.
